findings.impact: The bounded rollout implementation is plausible, but the restart and race guarantees in plan step 4 and acceptance check A4 are not fully demonstrated.

Delivery submissions assign fresh 72-hour windows. Revision clears the deadline; callbacks require the current review phase, version, matching deadline and matching funded offer amount.
Manual and automatic approval share the release transaction. Approved state prevents repeated settlement, and legacy release reasons default to manual.
